claim.quote: Improved limits on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton scattering cross section are extracted from this first period.

key_value_text.quote: An exposure in excess of 250 kg-days is obtained, with a live-time fraction reaching 80%.

name: Improved Spin-Dependent WIMP Limits from a Bubble Chamber

summary.plain: The first dark-matter search with a bubble chamber: 1.5 kg of superheated CF3I in a Fermilab neutrino tunnel gave improved limits on how strongly dark matter particles could couple to the spin of the proton.
summary.technical: 1.5 kg CF3I room-temperature bubble chamber at the 350-ft level of the NuMI tunnel; exposure in excess of 250 kg-days with a live-time fraction reaching 80%; rejection factor for photon-induced electrons of ~1e-10; improved limits on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section (Science 319, 933, 2008).

title: Improved Spin-Dependent WIMP Limits from a Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract says bubble chambers had fallen into disuse and that this work illustrates their use in a new realm, the search for dark matter particles.
